title: Taylen Green breaks QB vertical leap record at Combine, runs 40 in 4.36 seconds

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Taylen Green breaks QB vertical leap record at Combine, runs 40 in 4.36 seconds
sources.description: Taylen Green had mixed results as the starting quarterback at Arkansas over the last two seasons, but he may have helped his chances of getting drafted at the Scouting Combine in Indianapolis on Saturday.
